learning_outcomes.text: Students know modeling and optimization techniques and can apply them to real problems.
They can use appropriate software for modeling and solving optimization problems.
They are able to implement and evaluate the obtained solutions.

syllabus_topics: Modeling of linear optimization problems and integer optimization problems using case studies from areas such as: finance, personnel deployment planning, project management, chemical industry, production, transport and traffic, among others.
Application of modeling and optimization software: e.g. LPSolve, zimpl, LINDO, MS Excel
assessment_rules: The prerequisite for receiving credit points is a passed module exam. The weighting for the final grade is based on ECTS credit points.
bibliography: Linus Schrage: Optimization Modeling with LINGO, LINDO Systems Inc.
H.P. Williams: Model Building in Mathematical Programming, Wiley & Sons
Literature on individual case studies and documentation of the software used
